'''Watchtower Base''' was a watchtower located on [[Dorthus Tal Island]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]]. The tower was used to oversee the island's security and two hundred guards were garrisoned inside the facility. The base also contained various [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], listening devices, [[Security camera/Legends|cameras]], [[surveillance drone]]s and [[Jammer/Legends|jammers]]. It was rumored that the base was built to monitor the residents of [[Dorthus Tal City]], and as a result many off-worlders avoided spending prolonged periods of time in the [[City/Legends|city]].
